## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, sixth sitting: ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, then 2/7 times 3/8 as a decimal without writing anything down.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The classic they open with: 100 people board a plane, the first sits at random, everyone after sits in their own seat if free and at random otherwise. Probability the last passenger gets their own seat? Answer by symmetry in under a minute, then justify the symmetry out loud.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Conditional expectation, geometric flavour: you flip a fair coin until you see HH. Expected number of flips? Set up the states, solve, then do the same for HT and say out loud why the two answers differ.
:::
:::
